notes: Horizontal optical axes and identical perspective mask/shading; baseline recaptured before source edits. References are generated, not calibrated photographs.
Reference mask sections normalize full width by unchanged crop height, preserving aspect. Ground-shadow region below .875 is excluded by fitter.
Named local gates supplement whole-view score. Open bike spokes, shading, material visibility and unannotated contours require rendered review.
